verdict.rationale: As GPU hardware, the MI355X has no item-level bulk-operations feature in the SaaS sense. Its ecosystem does show fleet-level tooling that acts on many GPUs at once: AMD SMI manages and monitors GPUs and drivers, the GPU Operator deploys and manages Instinct GPUs across Kubernetes clusters, and the Spur scheduler handles GPU-first batch job scheduling. These descriptions are one-liners and never explicitly describe batch or bulk operations. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of bulk/batch operations across many GPUs or resources, scripted multi-target command examples, any hands-on or independent corroboration.
